title: Run the HumbleArchitect absorption pilot
summary: Use current product and operational evidence to make the bounded investment decision: embed one guided specification workflow in Studio and decide companion, shared module, or bounded absorption.
acceptance_criteria: Run the bounded decision program: embed one guided specification workflow in Studio and decide companion, shared module, or bounded absorption.
Use lifecycle disposition `build` and monetization posture `internal-now-optional-commercialization-later` as hypotheses, not predetermined outcomes.
Define the user or operator problem, baseline, expected value, investment, risks, and non-goals.
Identify the minimum reversible pilot and explicit stop criteria.
Identify the product, architecture, performance, accessibility, privacy, security, support, release, and data implications.
Estimate implementation, maintenance, infrastructure, model, platform fee, support, and Jan-time costs.
Define success, failure, uncertainty, and unavailable evidence.
Measure actual exposure or usage rather than assuming availability equals value.
Preserve privacy and avoid dark patterns or hidden automation.
Record qualitative feedback separately from observed behavior.
Record small-sample and confounding limitations.
Compare at least one credible alternative, including no change.
Define migration, compatibility, rollback, and retirement consequences.
For fusion, preserve standalone rollback and permission boundaries.
For monetization, cover entitlement, restore, management or cancellation, privacy, support, and App Store implications.
For personal or internal tools, allow no-monetization or maintenance-only as successful outcomes.
Do not execute irreversible merge, retirement, price, billing, release, data migration, or publication actions.
Produce an immutable decision artifact with owner, date, evidence, and reconsideration criteria.
Update the next 12-month roadmap only after human approval.
Record follow-up tickets only for accepted next steps.
Finish the decision review without app-owned warnings in its tooling and artifacts.

agent_notes: Non-scope: do not perform release, deployment, signing, external publication, destructive data operation, irreversible migration, or product merger.
Alternative considered and rejected: creating another abstract planning layer without implementable milestones would continue planning instead of delivering value.
Every implementation slice must be small, reviewable, evidence-backed, and warning-free.
Product role: internal visual product, design, diagram, and proposal workspace.
